scope: Qualification sampler; no production pipeline or acceptance threshold changes.
finding: A 410 ms realtime step inflated host heartbeat gaps to 661/662 ms while the Node/browser monotonic interval remained approximately 1006 ms. Browser timer delay in that interval was 1.1 ms. The original artifact and its failed verdict are retained.
limitations: The trial also fails impaired-link freezes; correcting the scheduler measurement does not establish delivery success.
The clock observation does not explain the persistent loss in run-1-relay-nack-rtx-flexfec.
The original sampler did not record boot-time intervals; historical heartbeat measurements are not retroactively converted.

correction.signalHandling: Terminate and reap the outstanding sleep when the sampler receives SIGINT or SIGTERM.

cases: Forward/backward civil-clock steps leave elapsed intervals unchanged; a real boot-time pause stays visible.
Terminating the sampler stops and reaps a pending 60-second sleep.
regression.before: Three assertions fail on the original sampler, including the realtime step and orphaned sleep.
regression.after: Three focused tests pass under macOS and Linux /bin/sh. The full 121-test collector suite passes. A live Linux /proc sample check passes with 11 samples and a maximum 60 ms observed gap at a configured 50 ms interval.
regression.fixtureSetup: The first Linux fixture attempt used a noexec tmpfs and could not start test scripts. Re-running with an explicitly executable temporary fixture filesystem passes; no production container permissions change.
